d_slot: Telegram's slot machine; three of a kind wins.
d_rand: A random number (1–100, or your own range: /rand 5 50).
d_choose: Picks one of your options: /choose tea, coffee, juice.
d_ball8: Ask a yes/no question, get an answer.
d_love: Reply to someone: how well you two match today.
d_rate: Rates anything from 0 to 10 (the same answer all day).
d_truth: A question to answer honestly (reply to give it to someone).
d_dare: A harmless challenge (reply to give it to someone).
d_act: Hug, pat, high-five, wave or cheer someone (as a reply).
d_couple: Two active members, the same pair all day.
d_motd: One active member, crowned for the day.
d_bday: Members save their birthday; the group greets them on the day.
d_daily: A few points once a day (when points are on).
d_guess: I think of a number 1–100; I say higher or lower.
d_typing: Type the sentence first — pasting doesn't count.
d_trivia: A quiz question as a Telegram quiz; the first right answer wins.
d_click: Tap the right emoji first; a wrong tap and you're out.
d_rps: Against Aegis, or reply to challenge someone.
list_words: Most also work as words, e.g. «dice», «quote», «trivia».
usage_ball8: Ask a question: /ball Will it rain?
usage_rate: Use: /rate pizza (or reply to a member)
usage_love: Reply to a member's message with /love
usage_ttt: Reply to a member's message with /ttt to challenge them
daily_off: The daily bonus needs points to be on in this group.
bday_unset: 🎂 You haven't saved your birthday here.
bday_how_j: Save it as month-day in the Persian calendar: /birthday 01-01 (remove: /birthday off).
game_busy: A game of this kind is already running here.
guess_start: 🔢 I'm thinking of a number from 1 to 100. Send your guesses! ({time})
click_start: ⚡ Tap the {emoji} first! A wrong tap and you're out.
click_wrong: ❌ Wrong one — you're out of this round.
rps_challenge: ✊ {a} challenges {b} to rock, paper, scissors! {b}, accept?
rps_pick: ✊ {a} vs {b} — both pick (your pick stays hidden).
rps_saved: Your pick is saved — waiting for the other player.
wait_accept: Waiting for the challenge to be accepted.
panel_intro: 36 fun features, each with its own switch, who may use it, a cooldown and a daily limit per member. Beyond the limit per minute, fun commands are ignored.
d_hafez: A ghazal from Hafez's Divan with its interpretation (/hafez, or /hafez 1–495 for a chosen one).
d_tarot: A tarot card and its meaning; /tarot 3 for past, present and future; /tarot with a question for yes or no.
d_horo: Today's horoscope: /horoscope Leo, /horoscope 21.03, or the birthday saved in the group.
d_abjad: The number of a name (abjad for Persian, Pythagorean for Latin letters) and what it means.
d_coffee: A symbolic coffee-cup reading: three signs and their meanings.
d_font: Your text in 220+ styles: beautiful combinations, Telegram styles, Unicode fonts, marks, Persian styles and frames — /font Hello (up to 40 characters).
usage_hafez: Use: /hafez, or /hafez 1–495 for a chosen ghazal
usage_tarot: Use: /tarot, /tarot 3, or /tarot Will I pass the exam?
usage_abjad: Use: /abjad and a name (up to 60 characters)
usage_font: Use: /font Hello (or reply to a message with /font)
d_clock: The meaning of the time now or of any time you send (/clock 12:21), and today's next symbolic times.
d_mirror: The meanings of the 24 mirror hours, like 11:11 and 22:22.
d_reversed: Reversed hours like 12:21 and 21:12, with their meanings.
d_triple: Triple hours like 03:33 and 04:44, with their meanings.
d_angel: Angel numbers like 111, 222 and 777, with their meanings.
d_sequence: Sequences like 1234, 2345 and 12321, with their meanings.
d_repeat: Repeating numbers like 1111, 2222 and 8888, with their meanings.
d_number: The meanings of repeating numbers 00 to 9999, and a reading of any other number (/number 1234).
d_birthmonth: Character, love, work, strengths and lucky colour, stone and day for your birth month (/birthmonth Libra, /birthmonth 21.03, or the saved birthday).
d_chinese: Your Chinese animal and element by birth year, and how this year treats you (/chinese 1991).
d_lifepath: Your life path number from your birth date and what it says about you (/lifepath 15.10.1991).
d_weekday: The weekday you were born on and what it means (/weekday 15.10.1991).
d_cards: Three playing cards for past, present and future, each with its meaning (/cards 1 for one card).
d_runes: A rune of the Elder Futhark, upright or reversed, with its meaning (/runes 3 for three).
d_iching: The Chinese Book of Changes: six coin throws make a hexagram, with its changing lines (/iching and your question).
d_tas: Three dice and the old meaning of their sum.
d_lenormand: Three cards of the 36-card Lenormand deck and how they read together (/lenormand 1 for one).
d_quran: The first verse of a random page of the mushaf, with a translation and the traditional way to read it; read it yourself or ask a scholar.
d_tasbih: Istikhara the prayer-bead way: beads counted two by two — good or not.
d_anbia: The old prophets' fortune: one of the prophets and a message from his story.
d_khayyam: A quatrain of Omar Khayyam with its interpretation (/khayyam, or /khayyam 1–178 for a chosen one).
d_babataher: A dobeyti (Persian couplet pair) of Baba Taher with its interpretation (/babataher, or /babataher 1–366 for a chosen one).
usage_khayyam: Use: /khayyam, or /khayyam 1–178 for a chosen quatrain
usage_babataher: Use: /babataher, or /babataher 1–366 for a chosen dobeyti
d_echo: Aegis deletes your message and sends the text itself; if you replied to a message, it replies to that message (/echo text).
usage_echo: Use: /echo text (you can reply to a message).
only_admins: In this group this command is for the owner and admins only.
only_special: In this group this command is for special members only.
cat_mode: 👥 Who can use this group: {v} The owner and admins choose the special members: reply to a member with /special. The owner and admins can always use it.
special_usage: 🎟 Reply to a member with /special, or give their id or @username. To remove: /unspecial.
special_unknown: 🎟 That member wasn't found in this group.
special_full: 🎟 The special members list is full ({n}).
special_added: 🎟 {user} is now a special member and may use the groups set to «special members».
special_removed: 🎟 {user} is no longer a special member.
